title: Account management
cmmc_level_1_requirement: Limit system access to authorized users
evidence: Account list with owners; disable and review dates

title: Access enforcement
cmmc_level_1_requirement: Limit access to permitted transactions and functions
evidence: Group permissions on Specified Information shares; screenshots

title: Use of external systems
cmmc_level_1_requirement: Verify and control connections to external systems
evidence: Policy on personal and external systems; agreements

title: Publicly accessible content
evidence: Review record for website and social posts

title: User identification, authentication, and re-authentication
evidence: Unique user IDs; no shared logins; re-authentication settings

title: Device identification and authentication
evidence: Device inventory; 802.1X or equivalent where used

title: Multi-factor authentication
evidence: MFA policy and enrolment report covering every account

title: Media sanitization
cmmc_level_1_requirement: Sanitize or destroy media before disposal or reuse
evidence: Sanitization and destruction log with method

title: Physical access authorizations
cmmc_level_1_requirement: Limit physical access to authorized individuals

title: Physical access control
cmmc_level_1_requirement: Escort visitors, keep physical access logs, control access devices
evidence: Door control, visitor log, key and card control, output devices

title: Boundary protection
cmmc_level_1_requirement: Monitor and control communications at boundaries; separate public components
evidence: Firewall rule set; managed interfaces; segmentation diagram

title: Flaw remediation
cmmc_level_1_requirement: Identify, report, and correct flaws in a timely manner

title: Malicious code protection
cmmc_level_1_requirement: Malicious code protection, kept updated, with periodic and real-time scans
evidence: Endpoint console showing current, scanning, blocking
